panel_line: Everyone on the server sees this.
panel_held: Paused for you by another script.
quake_idle: Pick where it strikes, then how big.
notice_real_time: The clock follows real time. Change the Time Zone in /ggsettings, under Shared Settings, General, or turn off Real Time under Weather System.
console_real_time: Real Time is on: the clock follows {zone}. Change the Time Zone in /ggsettings, under Shared Settings, General.
notice_weather_running: Weather changes on its own again.
notice_blackout_on: Blackout: the city lights are off.
notice_blackout_off: The city lights are back on.
notice_event_now: {weather}: look up, the sky is putting on a show.
notice_event_tonight: {weather} tonight: look up once it gets dark.
notice_event_by_day: {weather} only shows while the sun is up.
notice_storm: {weather} warning: it comes ashore in a few minutes. Get off the water and find shelter.
notice_storm_eyewall: The eyewall is here. Stay indoors.
notice_storm_eye: The eye is overhead: calm for a minute or two. The other side is coming.
notice_storm_back: The back of the eyewall: the wind has come round.
notice_storm_after: The worst is over: the hurricane is moving off.
notice_meteors_peak: The meteor storm is at its peak: watch for strikes.
notice_strike_none: No player is out for a meteor to hit near.
notice_quake_none: No earthquake is shaking right now.
not_allowed: You can't change the time or weather.
unknown: "{word}" isn't a weather, a sky look or a time. Try {command} rain or {command} 21:30.
unknown_look: "{word}" isn't a sky look. Try {command} look {example} or {command} look off.
usage: Try {command} freeze, {command} freeze time or {command} freeze weather.
unknown_place: "{word}" isn't a place earthquakes strike. Try {command} quake 6.5 {example}, or leave the place out.
console_restart_begun: Restart in {minutes} min: the Restart Weather is on.
console_restart_back: No restart after all: the sky is back as it was.
denied_old: Weather is for admins. Ask one to add your license ({license}) in /ggsettings, under Weather System, Access.
report_blackout: Blackout: the city lights are off
reports_closed: Only admins can check the weather on this server.
command_status_help: See the weather and time right now
